WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN disp dp ON o.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM account_orders
),
account_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.account_id,
    ao.region,
    ao.order_count,
    ao.order_count - oa.avg_count as diff_from_avg
  FROM account_orders ao, overall_avg oa
),
region_avg_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(diff_from_avg) as region_avg_diff
  FROM account_diffs
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  ad.account_id,
  ad.region,
  ad.order_count,
  ad.diff_from_avg,
  ad.diff_from_avg - rad.region_avg_diff as excess_diff
FROM account_diffs ad
JOIN region_avg_diffs rad ON ad.region = rad.region
WHERE ad.diff_from_avg > rad.region_avg_diff
ORDER BY excess_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
